name: De Morgan (¬(P∧Q) ⊢ ¬P∨¬Q)
description: De Morgan's law in Existential Graphs: the negation of a conjunction equals the disjunction of the negations. Because a disjunction A∨B is drawn ~[ ~[A] ~[B] ], the law is just the double-cut equivalence — two DC+ moves grow a double cut around each conjunct of ~[ (P) (Q) ], reaching ~[ ~[~[(P)]] ~[~[(Q)]] ]. A worked demonstration that EG disjunction is a double-negated form.
